messages:
rina-cs: Quick heads up — SolarFlare (new retail customer) needs a temporary APAC pilot window and a header allowlist for their partner proxy. Onboarding demo is tomorrow 2026-05-05 02:00 UTC. If demo goes poorly AMs flagged an early renewal_followup.

devin-ops: Details? spike size, duration, region preference, header or IP?

rina-cs: Product asks for +5x baseline QPS for 3 hours (02:00-05:00 UTC). Header allowlist only: header X-SF-Key with values like sf_live_{8digits}. Route to ap-southeast-1 primarily, fallback to ap-northeast-1. Also want a soft per-token cap of 200 rps to limit noisy neighbours. Auto-revoke after window. Tag account renewal_risk=medium.

tia-eng: We can add header pattern ^sf_live_[0-9]{8}$. For per-token cap we'll add a gateway rule to enforce 200 rps per token. Recommend fallback model sf-compact-q4_0 when p95 latency > 300ms sustained for 2m. Will also enable alerts for error_rate > 1.5% and p95 > 300ms.

devin-ops: Drafting CR. Will include rate_multiplier=5, window_start=2026-05-05T02:00:00Z, duration=3h, preferred=[ap-southeast-1], fallback=[ap-northeast-1], header_whitelist=X-SF-Key pattern, per_token_cap=200rps, fallback_model=sf-compact-q4_0, fallback_condition=p95>300ms_for_2m, alerts configured.

devin-ops: ```json
{
  "customer":"solarflare-retail",
  "change_request":"CR-2026-0610-sf-apac-pilot",
  "window_start":"2026-05-05T02:00:00Z",
  "duration":"3h",
  "rate_multiplier":"5",
  "region_policy":"preferred:[ap-southeast-1],fallback:[ap-northeast-1]",
  "header_whitelist":"X-SF-Key:^sf_live_[0-9]{8}$",
  "per_token_cap":"200",
  "fallback_model":"sf-compact-q4_0",
  "fallback_condition":"p95_latency>300ms_for_2m",
  "alerts":"error_rate>1.5%",
  "auto_revoke":"true"
}
```

infra-bot: Change CR-2026-0610-sf-apac-pilot applied: rate_multiplier=5 (ap-southeast-1 preferred), header allowlist added for X-SF-Key, per-token cap 200rps applied, fallback model sf-compact-q4_0 enabled with condition p95>300ms for 2m, alerts configured. Auto-revoke scheduled at 2026-05-05T05:00:00Z.

oliver-am: Noted. I'll mark renewal tracker renewal_risk=medium and plan a 1:1 post-demo touch with the customer. Rina please capture sample traces and any token auth failures during the window.

rina-cs: Will collect logs, token failure counts, sample traces, and a short customer diary. Will post a summary within 12h after the window. :white_check_mark:
